$comment: Curated mapping of every known axios/undici advisory (GHSA id) to a weakness class. Edit this file when the watcher reports a new advisory, then rebuild docs/vulnerability-baseline.json with `node tools/advisory-watch/build-baseline.mjs <osv-cache.json>`.

ssrf-base-url-escape.control: http: baseUrl origin lock (allowAbsoluteUrls=false) + guard destination policy

ssrf-redirect.control: guard.checkRedirect on every hop; maxRedirects enforced including 0

header-injection.control: RFC 9110 header name/value validation; strict method token; request option allow-list; WHATWG URL encoding

redirect-credential-leak.control: Authorization, Cookie, Proxy-Authorization (+ stripHeadersOnRedirect) removed on any origin change; proxy credentials only ever sent to the proxy

unbounded-response.control: maxResponseBytes enforced while reading, buffered and streamed; data: URLs refused by guard

decompression-abuse.control: single content-coding only (no chains), limit counted after decompression, decoder errors typed

unbounded-request.control: maxRequestBytes checked before sending on every transport

redos.control: no regex over attacker-controlled data except linear anchored patterns; parsing delegated to WHATWG URL and llhttp

prototype-pollution-gadget.control: own-property-only option reading; all security-relevant node:http/https/tls/http2 options pinned as own values; no URL objects passed to Node; bounded parseJson drops pollution keys

unbounded-recursion-request-data.control: request data serialised with JSON.stringify only; cyclic/unsupported data fails with ConfigError; no recursive form serialiser exists

tls-validation-bypass.control: TLS verification always on, no option to disable; rejectUnauthorized/checkServerIdentity pinned; ca carried through CONNECT tunnels and HTTP/2

http2-control-bypass-and-errors.control: HTTP/2 transport uses the guard lookup, refuses proxy combination, typed session errors, per-origin session cleanup

response-smuggling-desync.control: strict llhttp parser (insecureHTTPParser pinned false); failed connections are destroyed, never reused; retries re-issue whole requests and discard earlier bodies

supply-chain-compromise.control: zero third-party runtime dependencies, no install scripts, dev-only lockfile entries with sha512 integrity, enforced by test

no-proxy-bypass.control: Ametherian never reads HTTP_PROXY/NO_PROXY; the destination policy is applied to the target with or without a proxy (advanced.test.js: 'guard still checks the target URL')

browser-xsrf.control: Node-only client; no XSRF cookie-to-header feature

http-cache.control: no HTTP response cache; ametherian-cache is a generic in-process cache with collision-free scopes

cookie-jar.control: no cookie jar or Set-Cookie parsing

fetch-implementation-specific.control: behaviour specific to undici's fetch/body mixins, SRI, EventSource and interceptors, which Ametherian does not implement

runtime-tls-dos.control: TLS handshake/certificate parsing is done by Node's TLS stack; track Node.js security releases
